earth.name: Sunny Meadow
earth.subtitle: Home world

bloom.title: A Green Thread
bloom.text: Colour creeps back into the grass. Dr. Zonk says the soil remembers you.

bloom.title: The Meadow Stirs
bloom.text: Seeds you never planted push up overnight. The Vault is answering.

bloom.title: Full Bloom
bloom.text: The meadow is awake. One world down — and the sky is full of dark ones.

earth.intro: Everything grew from here once. Then the Bloom went quiet and the world forgot how. You still remember. Start small: a twig, a pebble, a berry.

projects.name: Clear the Path
talk: A visitor! Nobody has come up this path in years.
Tap the Meteor Heap for meteor chips. Two chips make a hot meteor. Two hot meteors clear the path!
projects.text: The path is clear! Behind the rubble: a heap of starstones.

projects.name: A Rock Border
talk: The space weeds walk into my garden like they own it. Rude.
Some crystal rocks and a metal ingot for a border, dear.
projects.text: A tidy border. Nana is very pleased. Next door, an old snack cart beeps awake.

projects.name: Nana Luma's Snacks
talk: Snacks! One food tube and some snack cubes for the picnic, and a rock to sit on.
The snacks are hereby confiscated. Mayoral privilege.
projects.text: First proper meal in years! Nana even washed the jars.

projects.name: A Table Under the Stars
talk: Citizens! A town needs a table. A table needs metal plates. And a glow geode, for dignity.
And a snack cube for whoever builds it.
projects.text: A fine table. Behind it, the old moonwater well starts to drip. ...Wait. What is that in the sky?

projects.name: Dr. Zonk's Workshop
talk: Blorp. Thank you for not screaming. Most planets scream.
I need a workshop: one Star Scrap, some metal plates and a shiny geode.
A REAL alien! Can I help? CAN I?
projects.text: Dr. Zonk's Lab hums to life. He wants to show you what it can do.

projects.name: Water for the Garden
talk: Tap the well: water drops make puddles, puddles make a canister.
A canister, some puddles, and a ration tray for the thirsty gardener.
projects.text: The garden perks up. On the hill, a little solar farm unfolds its panels.

projects.name: Power Supper
talk: A supper under the stars! Some solar cells for the lights, a ration tray and a water tank.
What is supper. I would like to learn about supper.
projects.text: Dr. Zonk had three trays.

projects.name: Mend the Fences
talk: Citizens! The fence is broken. Also a moon goat ate my hat.
A cargo crate of parts, a solar panel for the gate light and a star gem for the lock, please.
projects.text: The fence stands. The Meteor Heap gave its last metal and cools down for good. In its place, a little light stall opens.

projects.name: The Light Market
talk: Darling, a village without a light market is just houses in the dark.
Some glow bulbs for the stall, a gem for the sign and a jelly dome for the opening.
projects.text: The market glows! And buzzbots have moved in next door, just for a while.

projects.name: Nectar Jelly
talk: Nectar jelly! A hex cell of nectar, quickly, before the buzzbots leave.
And a space lamp to see by, and a fountain to wash the jars.
projects.text: Jelly for all. The starstones are all used up, and a fizz vent starts to bubble where they were.

projects.name: The Soda Stand
talk: A soda stand! Some drink pouches, a star lantern for the sign and an ice cream cone for the menu!
projects.text: Timmy sold four sodas. He drank nine. In the woods, an eyeshroom log is blinking awake.

projects.name: Forest Fizz
talk: My mother's forest fizz: a bunch of eyeshrooms and a can of soda.
And a panel array to keep it cold. Some traditions change.
On my world, soda is a colour. Fascinating.
projects.text: Fizz for everyone. The old well has done its job. Behind the shed: a jet wreck full of spare gear.

projects.name: Jet Day
talk: A jet boot and a light string so it looks cool!
Jetpacks do not care about lights, Ember.
THIS jetpack does. And a fizz bottle for the pilot.
projects.text: Timmy flew all evening. A suit loom hums nearby for a little while. Sirra has ideas.

projects.name: Spacesuits for All
talk: Everyone is dressed like a scare-bot. No offence to the scare-bot.
A space helmet, a twin jetpack and a pair of clean socks. I do the rest. I always do the rest.
projects.text: Suits for all. The snack cart is empty, and a toy chest turns up on the doorstep. Nobody ordered it.

projects.name: Toys for Everyone
talk: The children are bored. Bored children write petitions.
Some saucer tops, a hoverboard and antenna bobbles for the toy shelf. For the voters of tomorrow.
projects.text: The square is full of spinning tops. Mayor Marin pretends to dislike it.

projects.name: A Garden for Guests
talk: The space crows threaten civic order. I drafted a strongly worded letter.
Or a power station, a toy robot to scare them and a drink dispenser for the guards?
projects.text: The solar farm powers the last station and goes quiet. Grandma plants a hydro bed in its place.

projects.name: Grow Day
talk: Grow tubes! Some of them, dear. Real food grows in tubes now, apparently.
And a toy rocket! For... the harvest. And a star hourglass to time it.
projects.text: The first grow tubes are full. Then something small crashes behind the hill, blinking!

projects.name: The Little Visitors
talk: Blinkies! Babies. Far from home, like me.
Help one grow up: a hydro tray for its lunch and an orbit lamp for its room. Can we keep it?!
projects.text: The little visitors are safe and very hungry. The light stall is spent; a lens workbench takes its corner.

projects.name: Stargazing Night
talk: Dr. Zonk says his home is up THERE. Behind the Moon!
A spyglass, alien puppets for the little ones and a hand sprout to wave at the Moon. Nobody stargazes on an empty stomach.
projects.text: The Moon has tiny lights. "Friends," whispers Dr. Zonk. And in the woods: his ship. In pieces. Time to build a rocket!

projects.name: Lenses for the Dome
talk: To fly, I must see. A brass telescope, please.
And a grow rack and a drink dispenser for the long nights of building.
projects.text: The fizz vent sighs its last bubble. Down by the water, a slime pond fills up.

projects.name: Slime Day
talk: A party at the slime pond! Slime deserves nice things.
Some slime puddles to splash in, a toy starport for the prizes and a bath bomb for afterwards.
projects.text: The slime frogs hold a party. The Duchess sends her cargo pod ahead of her.

projects.name: Fizz in the Garden
talk: Duchess Splatt. I have come a very long way for a proper picnic.
A cargo crate of fine things, a slime jar to keep it cool and an observatory. One must see the stars while dining.
projects.text: Picnic under the stars. The jet wreck is picked clean; a cheese mill creaks into life instead.

projects.name: The Cheese Shop
talk: Chef Gubbo, cheese master. Well, cheese master without a shop.
Some cheese cubes to start, a slime frog to guard them, and a map roll so the customers can find the shop.
projects.text: The cheese shop is open. Moon cheese for everyone!

projects.name: Cheese and Slime
talk: The finest pairing in the galaxy: a cheese wheel and a slime fountain.
And a telescope. For... cheese astronomy.
projects.text: Nobody understood the pairing. Everybody ate it. The toy chest is empty; a goo pit bubbles by the river.

projects.name: Goo Day
talk: Cheese but no bowls. Uncivilised, darling.
Some goo lumps, a goo pot and a cheese stack for the potters. There is moon goo by the river.
projects.text: Sirra ordered twelve vases. A little weather cloud drifts over, just for a while.

projects.name: Rain for the Pond
talk: The pond is low. On my world we would ask the sky nicely.
A zap cloud, an orbit urn to catch the rain, and a cheese wheel for the cloud. Clouds like cheese. I assume.
projects.text: Rain! The hydro bed rests, and behind the crates, pet eggs start to wobble.

projects.name: Pets for the Blinkies
talk: A blobling to play with, some goo pots for its dinner, a slime pool for its bath and soap. Lots of soap.
projects.text: The Blinkies have a pet now. It has their sash.

projects.name: The Pet Show
talk: A pet show! Blobbo the blob pup is entered in every category.
A rocket kiln for the trophies and a cheese cart for the snacks.
projects.text: Blobbo won everything. The cheese mill retires with honours, and a busker bot rolls in to play.

projects.name: The Space Parade
talk: A parade before the launch! A planet drum, a blob bed for the float, an orbit urn and a photo to remember it.
projects.text: Best parade ever. The goo pit is dry. Under it, an old scrap hull full of rocket bits. "Nearly there," says Dr. Zonk.

projects.name: The Launch Pad
talk: A nose cone, a telescope, some slime jars to cool the engines, and a blob pup. It insists on coming.
Miss you? No. You are coming too.
projects.text: The rocket stands. Sunny Meadow is awake, and the Moon is waiting.

luna.name: Crater Camp
luna.subtitle: Luna

bloom.title: Dust Remembers
bloom.text: Glow spores drift up out of the regolith. Nothing has grown here in an age.

bloom.title: The Craters Sing
bloom.text: Light pools in the low places. Moonbeam says it sounds like a choir tuning up.

bloom.title: Luna Awake
bloom.text: The grey moon is silver now, and gardens ring every crater rim.

luna.intro: Luna went cold first — no air, no argument. But the Vault says a world only needs one living thing to start over. Find it.

projects.name: Light the Camp
talk: Oh, far out. Visitors. Sorry it is so dark, man — the lamps gave up years ago.
Two moon shards and a glow pod and I can make a little ring of light. Vibes first, then everything else.
Kix stowed away in the cargo hold. Kix regrets nothing. Kix is cold.
projects.text: A little ring of glow around the tents. Behind them, a flat of moon dust is ready to dig.

projects.name: Build a Dust Wall
talk: GREETINGS. I AM ROKK. I WAS THE BUTLER OF THIS CAMP. THE CAMP LEFT. I STAYED.
THE DUST STORMS KNOCK OVER THE TENTS. TWO REGOLITH BRICKS AND ONE MOON CORE FOR THE KEYSTONE. PLEASE.
projects.text: WALL: STANDING. WIND: BLOCKED. ROKK: PROUD.

projects.name: The Crystal Garden
talk: Ah. Tourists. Mind the moon stars, they are older than your planet and twice as interesting.
A moon star and a pod cluster. I am building a garden. A tasteful one. You would not understand.
projects.text: Nix has a garden. Rokk found an ice vein and an old wick pod behind it.

projects.name: Lanterns for the Dark Side
talk: THE FAR SIDE IS DARK FOR FOURTEEN DAYS AT A TIME. I DO NOT LIKE IT. I AM NOT AFRAID. I AM A ROBOT.
A MOON LANTERN AND AN ICE SHARD TO FOCUS IT. FOR NO REASON. NOT FEAR.
projects.text: Rokk walks the far side at night now. Humming. Rokk does not hum. Rokk is humming.

projects.name: Catch a Comet
talk: A comet passes every night at nine, man. Like clockwork. Like a really cold friend.
Catch a ball of its clear ice, and bring a pod lamp so we can see it. Comets carry seeds, you know. Old ones.
Blorp. She is right. I checked. I hate it when the hippie is right.
projects.text: The comet's ice was full of old seeds. Moonbeam planted every one.

projects.name: Moon Launch Pad
talk: Kix has a business proposal. A launch pad. Kix builds, you pay, everybody flies.
Moon brick, a moon orb for the guidance light, one beacon so the pilot does not miss. Kix missed once. Long story.
There is a fire planet in range. Ember Hollow. Bring a fire extinguisher.
projects.text: Pad ready! The old geyser and the glow pods are spent, but a crystal spire and a silver seam just broke through. Ember Hollow is in range now! And something small is bouncing out of a crater: a moon pup nest!

projects.name: A Home for the Pups
talk: Those bouncing things are moon pups. They chew crystals. MY crystals.
Give them a burrow far from my garden. A pup to show the others the way, and a prism shard to chew instead of mine.
projects.text: The pups have a burrow with a view. They bounce off the walls. Literally.

projects.name: The Rover Garage
talk: Kix found an old rover. Kix needs a garage. A moon wall and a silver ingot for the door.
THERE WILL BE NO GRAND OPENING.
There will be a SMALL grand opening.
projects.text: A garage with a silver door. The rover is still in pieces. Kix calls that "potential".

projects.name: Fuel the Heaters
talk: THE HEATERS NEED COOLANT AND A FOCUS. EVERYONE IS COLD. MOSTLY ME. I AM METAL.
ONE GLACIER BLOCK AND ONE PRISM CORE. THE IRONY IS NOT LOST ON ME.
projects.text: WARM. The dust flat and the ice vein are mined out. A comet trail lands nearby, and the scrapyard wakes up full of little bots.

projects.name: Call Home
talk: The old dish still points at the sky. If it turns again, the camp can talk to everyone out there.
A lighthouse for the signal, a comet core for the tuner, and a little cup bot to turn the dish. Mostly for the vibes.
Fine. I will admit it. I would like to call someone.
projects.text: The dish turns, the stars answer. Crater Camp is part of the sky again.

projects.name: The Fortune Tent
talk: I saw you coming! In my crystal ball! ...It was cracked, so you were in three pieces. Still.
A prism heart for a new ball and a comet stone to make it shine. Then I can see the future in ONE piece.
She is a fraud. A charming fraud. I want my fortune read.
projects.text: Madame Oops reads fortunes by the craters now. She is right about a third of the time. Nix says that is a record. An algae vine pokes out of the soil, just for a while.

projects.name: The Algae Dome
talk: Everybody keeps arriving, man, and everybody is hungry. Visitors eat a LOT.
An algae tank to start the dome, and a silver chalice for the first harvest. Green food, good vibes.
I DO NOT EAT. I WILL SUPERVISE THE EATING.
projects.text: Algae soup for everyone. The wick pods and the crystal spire have given all they had, and a helium vent and a relay mast take their place.

projects.name: Captain Glimmer's Moon Show
talk: MAGNIFICENT! A moon with NO show! I, Captain Glimmer, shall fix that at once.
A silver crown for the star (me), a comet heart for the finale, and a parcel pod full of invitations. They will come. They always do.
Kix sells the tickets. Kix has already sold the tickets.
projects.text: Standing ovation. Glimmer took eleven bows. A fresh impact crater smokes at the edge of camp.

projects.name: The Skyfall Museum
talk: All these visitors and nothing to look at but me. I am wonderful, but I am not enough.
A museum. A pallasite for the main hall, a digger bot to find more, and a gas canister for the lights. Labels in my handwriting.
projects.text: The museum opened at dawn. The labels are very long. Everybody reads them anyway.

projects.name: The Deep Space Ear
talk: THE DISH HEARS THE OTHER WORLDS. NOW I WANT TO HEAR FURTHER. PAST THE EDGE OF THE MAP.
A RADAR DISH, A HELIUM TANK TO POWER IT AND A WALKER BOT TO KEEP IT POINTED. I WILL LISTEN. I AM GOOD AT LISTENING.
Blorp. If something out there says hello, I want to know first.
projects.text: Something out past the map is humming back. Rokk has started humming along again. He denies it.

cindra.name: Ember Hollow
cindra.subtitle: Cindra

bloom.title: Ash to Soil
bloom.text: Where the ash cooled, something soft is growing through it.

bloom.title: The Hollow Breathes
bloom.text: The vents sigh instead of roaring. Vulk has not seen that in his lifetime.

bloom.title: Cindra Reborn
bloom.text: Fire and garden, at the same time, without either winning. That is the whole trick.

cindra.intro: Cindra never went dormant — it went furious. The Bloom here did not die of cold. It burned. Ash is still soil, if you are patient.

projects.name: Rekindle the Forge
talk: HRM. A visitor. The forge has been cold for a hundred years. I have been angry for a hundred and one.
Two cinders and an ash shroom. The forge eats, then it works. Like me.
projects.text: The forge breathes. Vulk pretends it was nothing. Behind it, an old iron seam glints.

projects.name: New Tools
talk: The forge breathes. Now it needs tools. My old ones melted. My mood melted them.
An iron ingot and a lava blob to temper it. Hot things. Good things.
projects.text: Hammers, tongs and one very large spoon. Vulk will not explain the spoon.

projects.name: The Market Stall
talk: A REAL VISITOR! Do you want a mushroom? I grow mushrooms! I grow TOO MANY mushrooms!
A great shroom for the stall roof and two iron nuggets for the frame. Travellers will come. They will! Probably!
projects.text: Fizz sells mushrooms to travellers who have not arrived yet. Vulk dug out an obsidian slab and a star coal pit. A fire gel spring bubbles up for a little while.

projects.name: Stew for Everyone
talk: Everyone here is grumpy because nobody has eaten. Vulk has not eaten since the volcano.
I had a rock in spring.
A jar of fire gel and a forge flame. STEW. The spiciest stew in the system.
projects.text: Very, very spicy. Nobody complained. Nobody could speak.

projects.name: The Bell Tower
talk: The vents roar at night. The old bell used to calm them. It cracked.
An obsidian blade for a new clapper and a fire opal to make it ring true. Then we sleep.
projects.text: The bell rings at sunset. The vents seem to quieten when it does.

projects.name: Heat-Proof Launch Pad
talk: A launch pad on a planet made of fire. Blorp. What could go wrong.
Iron anvil for the base. Dark mirror to throw the heat back. Bellows to cool the engines.
And a little flag! I will make the flag!
projects.text: It will not melt. Probably. The lava vent and the shroom log are spent, so Vulk opened a hot sand pit and a copper seam. Tidal Shallows is in range! And firebirds are circling an old ash nest.

projects.name: Nests for the Firebirds
talk: The firebirds keep sleeping in Vulk's boots.
An ember egg and a glass bead to keep it warm — they need a nest of their own!
projects.text: Tiny flames curled in warm glass. They follow Fizz everywhere now.

projects.name: The Quiet Hall
talk: Too many people now. Meetings. Opinions. I need a hall with a door that closes.
A great cog for the door and a glass vase, so Fizz stops putting flowers in my helmet.
projects.text: A hall with a heavy door. Meetings happen there now. Vulk sits by the door.

projects.name: Pipes for the Hollow
talk: GREETINGS AGAIN. I FOLLOWED THE HEAT. HEAT IS POWER. POWER IS ORDER.
A COPPER BELL FOR THE ALARM AND A GREAT FORGE TO HEAT THE PIPES. THE SMELL IS UNFORTUNATE. THE PROGRESS IS NOT.
projects.text: PRESSURE: NOMINAL. The iron and obsidian are mined out. A sulfur spring starts to fizz, and lava snails crawl out of a warm nest. A charred stump starts to glow like a lava lamp.

projects.name: The Lava Lights
talk: Lava lamps all over the hollow! Light that is warm when you touch it!
A big lava lamp, a glass lily and a sulfur crystal to mark the spot.
And then the oceans, friend. Tidal Shallows. You will need a towel.
projects.text: The hollow glows from end to end. Cindra is reborn.

projects.name: The Grub Brothers' Stall
talk: Deal! We heard there is a fire planet with customers. (He heard. I came anyway.)
A box of fireworks to sell and a glass vase for the counter. Classy. Best stall on the planet. Only stall on the planet.
If they sell my spoon I will be angry.
projects.text: The stall sells everything twice: once by each brother.

projects.name: Dragonlet Daycare
talk: The fire critters had babies! Then the babies had OPINIONS!
A magma dragonlet to keep the little ones in line and a volcano snail to slow them down. Carefully! Mostly carefully!
projects.text: Tiny dragons asleep in warm sand. The coal pit and the sand pit are spent, and a steam vent and a basalt cliff rise up.

projects.name: The Clockwork Tower
talk: Kix has noticed nobody here is ever on time. Kix sees a business: TIME.
A copper clock and a steam engine to wind it. Kix will charge per minute. Small minutes.
I WILL KEEP THE TIME. FOR FREE. SORRY, KIX.
projects.text: The tower chimes every hour. Rokk is never late now. Kix is still a bit late. On purpose.

projects.name: The Great Fire Show
talk: MAGNIFICENT! A planet made of fireworks and NOBODY has done a show? Tragic. Leave it to me.
A firework cannon for the big bang, a brimstone heart for the smell, and a basalt gate to make my entrance. I always make an entrance.
Hrm. If it is loud, I am in.
projects.text: The sky over the hollow went gold, then red, then gold. Vulk clapped. Nobody had seen Vulk clap before.

projects.name: The Basalt Citadel
talk: A hundred years ago we had a citadel. The volcano took it. I want it back. Bigger.
Giant's steps for the gate, a copper clock for the tower and a lamp snail to light the way. Not for me. I am too grumpy to rule.
You would be a lovely king, Vulk!
projects.text: The citadel shines black and red over the hollow. Vulk sits on the step next to the empty throne.

nerith.name: Tidal Shallows
nerith.subtitle: Nerith

bloom.title: The Water Clears
bloom.text: Silt settles. For the first time in centuries you can see the reef floor.

bloom.title: Reefs Return
bloom.text: Coral climbing the old ruins, fish following it up. Pearl will not stop humming.

bloom.title: Nerith Alive
bloom.text: A whole drowned world, breathing again through its gills.

nerith.intro: Nerith drowned slowly and politely. The cities are still down there under the shallows, full of shells and nothing else. Wake the reef and the rest follows.

projects.name: Clean the Beach
talk: Oh! Hello! Welcome to the Shallows! Mind the bubbles. And the other bubbles. It is all bubbles, sorry.
Two sea shells and a bubble cluster and I can clear a path to the water. Then we can paddle!
projects.text: Sand you can actually walk on. A coral head is growing back by the rocks.

projects.name: Replant the Reef
talk: The reef used to be every colour. Now it is mostly beige. Beige is not a reef colour.
Two coral sprigs to plant, and a bubble jar to keep them company. Corals get lonely.
projects.text: Little corals in neat rows. The first swimmers arrived an hour later.

projects.name: The Critter Market
talk: Harbourmaster Brine. Forty years on this pier. Thirty-nine of them grumpy.
No market, no gossip. A great shell for the counter and a coral fan for shade. Hop to it.
projects.text: The market bubbles with gossip. Brine found an oyster bed and a tide pool under the pier.

projects.name: The Store Room
talk: Supplies go off down here. Everybody knows that. Except Kelpa, who keeps a swimmer in a jar "as a friend".
A pearl for the lock and some sea foam to pack it all in. Please.
projects.text: Enough stores for the whole winter. Brine counted twice.

projects.name: Raise the Wreck
talk: There is an old saucer at the bottom of the bay. My first ship. I sank it. Long story. Short storm.
A nautilus to patch her hull and a tide swell to lift her. Pilots are superstitious. I am VERY superstitious.
projects.text: The old saucer floats again. Pearl swears it is the same one her grandmother flew.

projects.name: The Floating Launch Pad
talk: Blorp! The next world is up there. The only flat thing here is the water. So the launch pad will float.
Floating launch pads. In my day we launched things by throwing them.
A shell horn for the hull, a coral crown to steady it, a bubble helmet for the pilot.
projects.text: It bobs a bit. The shell bed and the bubble bed are spent; a critter trap and a crystal pan take over. Aurora Reach is in range! Up the beach, a nesting beach is full of wobbling eggs.

projects.name: Guard the Shellkins
talk: The shellkins are hatching! All at once! There are SO MANY of them!
A shellkin to show the others the way, and a three-eye swimmer to guide them to the water. Gently!
projects.text: Every shellkin made it to the water. Kelpa counted every single one, out loud.

projects.name: The Crystal Pier
talk: Subs are coming in from the other worlds now. Rocket subs. Whatever those are.
A proper pier needs a crystal pillar and a pearl strand for the lamps. Do it right or do not do it.
projects.text: Subs come and go. Some of them from worlds you woke.

projects.name: Mood Lighting
talk: Darling, the Shallows are lovely by day, but by night? Pitch black. Unacceptable.
A tidal orb that glows and two crystal cubes to hang it from. Everybody deserves mood lighting.
projects.text: The shallows glow at night. The coral and the oysters rest; a saucer wreck and a light vent full of jellies wake up.

projects.name: Wake the Drowned City
talk: There is a city under the bay. My grandmother said so. She also said she was a mermaid queen, so.
The city is real. I have seen the domes at low tide.
A sunken robot, a crystal temple and a jellyling to swim through the gate — the old songs say that opens it.
projects.text: The domes break the surface, glittering. Nerith breathes again.

projects.name: Parcels by Sub
talk: Parcel! For... the bottom of the sea. Sign here. Any leg. Any tentacle.
A porthole pod to deliver it and a float jelly to carry me back up. Six legs do not swim. I checked.
projects.text: Postie Blorb now delivers under water. Parcels arrive a bit damp. Nobody minds.

projects.name: The Big Aquarium
talk: Gerald is lonely! Gerald needs a BIG home with friends!
Gerald is a swimmer in a jar.
An aquarium and a lantern critter so he has a night light. He gets scared. Like me.
projects.text: Gerald has two hundred friends now. The tide pool and the critter trap rest, and a sub dock and a glass beach open up.

projects.name: Madame Oops Reads the Tides
talk: The sea told me a secret! I did not understand it. It was very wet.
An abyss orb and a glass float. Orbs see everything. Floats see... up. I mostly guess.
Darling, she guessed my birthday. I am impressed and a little scared.
projects.text: The tides now arrive exactly when Oops says. Nobody knows if she predicts them or tells them. Out in the deep, the gliders are gathering.

projects.name: The Glider Races
talk: Darling, the gliders are faster than anything with an engine. Let us prove it!
A star glider to lead the race and a racing sub to chase it.
projects.text: The star glider won by a fin. The sub driver demands a rematch.

projects.name: The Crystal Lighthouse
talk: Ships from every world come here now. One more thing and the Shallows are a proper port.
A crystal lighthouse, a champion sub to guide ships in and a jelly mum to keep the bay calm. Forty years I waited for this.
projects.text: The lighthouse sweeps the bay. Brine has stopped being grumpy. Thirty-nine years was enough.

vela.name: Aurora Reach
vela.subtitle: Vela

bloom.title: First Light
bloom.text: A thread of aurora, thin as a hair, stitched across the dark.

bloom.title: The Sky Weaves
bloom.text: Whole curtains of it now. Halo says the Vault is singing back.

bloom.title: The Bloom Returns
bloom.text: Every world you woke is visible from here, lit up like lamps in a long hallway. You did that.

vela.intro: The last place the Bloom was seen alive. There is no ground here — only cloud, light and whatever you can grow on them. This is where it ends, or begins again.

projects.name: Solid Ground
talk: Wheee! Oh — visitors! Careful, there is no ground. There is no ground ANYWHERE. Isn't it great?
A big cloud puff and some aurora silk to stitch it down, and you will have something to stand on.
projects.text: A cloud you can stand on. Nearby, a star cradle starts to twinkle.

projects.name: Stitch the Sky
talk: Hello. I have been expecting you for three hundred years. You are slightly late.
The sky is torn. An aurora veil to mend it and two starlets to pin it in place.
projects.text: One stripe of colour across the dark. Halo keeps looking up.

projects.name: Cloud Pillows
talk: Chirrup! New faces! Did you hear about Zephyr? Fell off a cloud. TWICE. Anyway.
Cloud pillows float off unless you pin them. A thunderhead and two star sparks, please!
projects.text: Pillows on every cloud. A wind vane spins up, and a jelly cloud drifts in to stay.

projects.name: Cloud Jelly
talk: Cloud jelly! It floats off unless you hold it down.
A jelly jar and a wind coil to keep it put. Chirrup!
projects.text: Wobbly jelly on every cloud. The cloud critters found it before anyone. A sky nest drifts past, full of fluff.

projects.name: Nests on the Wind
talk: The sky birds are coming home! I told everyone first. Obviously.
A cloud nest to line and a star cluster to keep them warm at night.
projects.text: Nests on every cloud. The sky birds are home.

projects.name: Sails for the Islands
talk: The islands drift apart and nobody visits anybody. Let us fix that!
A wind vane to steer by, an aurora cloak for a sail, and a jelly cake for the trip. Mostly the cake.
projects.text: Sails between the islands. The cloud bank and the aurora loom rest now; a chime post and a prism stand catch the wind. Something twinkles in a little star den.

projects.name: A Den for the Star-Kits
talk: The star-kits are frightened. They were born after the Bloom left and have never seen it.
A star sprite to lead them and a chime bell to sing them to sleep.
projects.text: The little star-kits have a den of their own. They glow brighter when you visit.

projects.name: Tune the Chimes
talk: The chimes stopped ringing when the Bloom left. Nobody has gossiped properly since. Tragic.
A chime tower and a prism lens to tune it. Chirrup!
projects.text: The chimes play a tune nobody taught them. Halo says it is the Vault singing back.

projects.name: The Prism Array
talk: The light is coming back. We should catch it before it slips away again.
A prism array to catch it and a star forge to feed it.
projects.text: Light pours across the Reach. The star cradle and the wind vane rest; a silk loom and a solar array take their turn.

projects.name: The Drift Yards
talk: Balloons! Big ones! Between EVERY island!
A drift balloon and a stack of moon wafers for the passengers. Wheee!
projects.text: Balloons between the islands. Everyone can visit everyone now. A drone pad lands on the next cloud over.

projects.name: Sky Mail
talk: Parcel! For... a cloud. Which cloud? They all move. This is the worst route in the galaxy.
A balloon airship to carry the mail and a drone for the tricky clouds. Then I can finally be on time. Once.
projects.text: Sky mail flies every morning. Postie Blorb has been on time twice. A record.

projects.name: The Orbital Station
talk: Kix has found a business opportunity. Satellites! Every world talking to every world. Kix sells the phones.
Kix. That is just a network.
A comm satellite and a room module for the staff. Kix will handle the rest.
projects.text: Every camp on every world can talk to every other. A nebula pool and a gravity well open up beneath the station.

projects.name: The Grand Orrery
talk: I would like to see every world you woke, all at once, turning in the light.
A ringed planet for the centre and a nebula lamp to light it.
projects.text: Little worlds turn in the lamp light. Halo watches the Meadow the longest.

projects.name: The Rainbow Bridge
talk: What if you could walk from cloud to cloud? Without falling? I fell twice today!
A rainbow bridge, and a nebula globe to light it at night. Whee!
projects.text: A bridge of every colour from one end of the Reach to the other. Zephyr has crossed it forty times.

projects.name: The Bloom Returns
talk: This is it. The very last piece of the Vault. Everything we carried, from the Meadow to here.
An orbital station to hold the light, twin planets to balance it, and a solar station to power it.
Blorp. Rokk heard a hum from past the edge of the map. So did I. Something out there is waving.
projects.text: Five worlds, all lit. The Vault is empty and the galaxy is full. And past the edge of the map, something waves back... To be continued.
